note: The request leg rows come from the five third-party harness shapes added 2026-10-03 (router-infra#91: opencode, pi, omp, Hermes, OpenClaw), derived from each release's request builder and cross-checked with the 2026-10-02 smoke key lists; they are not byte captures. No provider response or recorded stream on this format exists on disk, so those legs remain unmeasured. Capturing one is operator-owed.

fields.note: ["reasoning.encrypted_content"] from every harness running store:false. Carried to a Responses target; a Chat arm's reasoning_details answer it with a minted encrypted_content.
Per-session cache key (opencode session id, pi/omp session id, Hermes pck_ hash). Carried to a Responses target only; the gateway also keys sessions on it.
"24h" from pi with long cache retention. Carried to a Responses target only.
"auto" from every harness with reasoning on. Carried to a Responses target only.

A resent reasoning item holding encrypted_content, carried whole. A Responses target gets it only when the episode's issuer record says that target issued it (atlasfutures/semantic-router#109); every other target drops it. A reasoning item the Router minted from reasoning_details is not this row: it decodes back into content.reasoning_details.
